title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the immediate blocks and corridors surrounding D'Youville University's West Side campus, featuring academic hubs, athletic fields, and community landmarks.

cards.title: The Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: Porter Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the heart of campus to start a tour or meet with admissions. This historic building serves as the primary administrative hub for the university.
cards.short_summary: The central administrative building and primary visitor starting point on Porter Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Most tours and admissions events begin at the Koessler Administration Building (KAB), located at 320 Porter Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard university business hours; visitor parking is available directly in front.

cards.title: Community Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Connecticut Street
cards.notes: Access primary care, a public pharmacy, and a neighborhood cafe in this state-of-the-art facility designed for interprofessional education.
cards.short_summary: A 57,000-square-foot health facility offering medical services and student training on Connecticut Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Professions Hub is located at 301 Connecticut Street and includes a pharmacy, clinic, and demonstration kitchen.
cards.access_notes: The building is open to the public; specific clinic and pharmacy hours vary.

cards.title: Academic Innovation Hub
cards.subtitle: Niagara Street
cards.notes: Study in modern labs and smart classrooms within this renovated historic landmark that houses the School of Arts, Sciences and Education.
cards.short_summary: A $26.7 million academic facility featuring research labs and a student cafe on Niagara Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dr. Charles and Mary Schweitzer Bauer School of Arts, Sciences and Education Building is located at 605 Niagara Street.
cards.source_title: The School of Arts, Sciences and Education Opens $26.7 Million Facility | D'Youville
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students and faculty with university ID; public access for specific events.

cards.title: Historic Performance Space
cards.subtitle: Prospect Avenue
cards.notes: Attend a professional theater production in this intimate 250-seat Victorian-style auditorium known for its rococo architecture.
cards.short_summary: An award-winning professional theater located within the D'Youville campus on Prospect Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kavinoky Theatre's main entrance is on Prospect Avenue, housed in a Victorian-style auditorium.
cards.source_title: Who We Are — D'Youville Kavinoky Theatre
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled performances; accessible entrance via Parking Lot A off Fargo Avenue.

cards.title: Saints Athletic Complex
cards.subtitle: Fourth Street
cards.notes: Watch the Saints compete in soccer, lacrosse, or softball at this $5.5 million lighted turf athletic complex near the waterfront.
cards.short_summary: The primary outdoor athletic facility for D'Youville University sports on Fourth Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Dobson Field is located at 602 Fourth Street and serves as the home for soccer, lacrosse, and softball.
cards.access_notes: Open for university athletic events and scheduled rentals.

cards.title: Modern Campus Living
cards.subtitle: West Avenue
cards.notes: Live in fully furnished quad or double apartments featuring a recreation area and resident-only gated parking.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated residential complex for D'Youville students located on West Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Apartment Complex is located at 222 West Avenue and features fully furnished apartments.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents and authorized guests; electronic access cards required.

cards.title: Visitor Parking Hub
cards.subtitle: Fargo Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize the primary visitor parking area for the Kavinoky Theatre and campus events located off this neighborhood traffic circle.
cards.short_summary: A key campus access point and parking area located on Fargo Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Lot A, which has dedicated parking spots for visitor parking, is located off the Fargo Avenue Circle.
cards.access_notes: Visitor parking available; permit required for student and faculty spots.

cards.title: Indoor Athletics Hub
cards.subtitle: Porter Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the university's main gymnasium for indoor sports and recreational activities, originally established in 1969.
cards.short_summary: The primary indoor athletic and recreational facility located on Porter Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saints Center Gym is located at 329 Porter Avenue.
cards.source_title: Saints Center - Facilities - D'Youville University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open for university athletic events and student recreation.

cards.title: Saints Gear & Supplies
cards.subtitle: Prospect Avenue
cards.notes: Purchase university apparel, textbooks, and school supplies at the official campus retail location.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore and retail shop located on Prospect Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The D'Youville University Campus Store is located at 569 Prospect Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during standard retail hours.

cards.title: Administrative Annex
cards.subtitle: Jersey Street
cards.notes: Find various university offices including Alumni Association and Human Resources in this block near the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A university-owned complex housing administrative and alumni offices near Jersey Street.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Youville owns buildings at 605 and 631 Niagara Street, encompassing a portion of the block on Jersey Street.
cards.source_title: D'Youville Purchases Former Gateway-Longview Building | D'Youville
cards.access_notes: Administrative offices; open during university business hours.
